verdict.rationale: Angular's first-party site claims 'reactive and fast state updates with fine-grained reactivity based on Angular Signals,' which directly matches declaring reactive state and re-running only dependent code. The community complaints about dirty-checking digest cycles describe legacy AngularJS, not Signals, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing signal declaration, computed/effect dependency tracking and targeted template updates, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the fine-grained behavior.
